title: CJP Protest Day 6: Abhijeet Dipke extends gratitude to supporters for 'home-cooked food'
summary: The Cockroach Janta Party's protest, led by founder Abhijeet Dipke, entered day 6 on Thursday. On this occasion, Dipke extended gratitude to volunteers for ‘bringing home-cooked food’ and for their support in the sit-in at Jantar Mantar.
